title: Ledger claim graph (derived)
description: The single interrogable view of an argument, emitted by build_graph.py from the in-band edges, the inquiry question tree, and the judgement records. Derived (never hand-edited, git-ignored); a fresh clone rebuilds it. An empty project yields empty arrays.

nodes.description: Every claim address (<ledger_key>:<slug>) that appears as an edge endpoint or an assessment subject.

source.description: <from_ledger>:<grounding> — the grounding claim is the natural source endpoint; null if no grounding clause.

target.description: The claim the edge points at, as <ledger_key>:<slug>.

grounding.description: The grounding claim slug in from_ledger (the quote where the relationship is asserted).

target_resolved.description: Whether target names a real claim in a present ledger.

rec.description: An assessment record id judging this edge apt (edge_assessments), or null.

line.description: Line number of the edge in its ledger.

field.description: The in-band field that referenced the sub-question (addresses / crux-of).

reviews.description: Edge-record ids this record positively reviews (faithfulness-pass).

findings.description: DERIVED heuristics, not proofs: correlated supporters of one claim (possible double-count) and claims a supersedes edge overtook.
